text_block_list.text: —All right. Looks like all luggage loaded.
—All right. Looks like all luggage loaded.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Very well. ...Team <Ascella>! Everyone here? Final check before departure!

text_block_list.name: Antenna-haired Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Okaaay~, Team Member #1 present~. Luggage loaded~.

text_block_list.name: Single Knot Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Ready too! Brought snacks, let's eat on the way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Thought bag looked heavy... geez. ...New members, all set?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. Cesario here, all clear.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Line Craft ready! ...Um, probably didn't forget anything.
P-probably? If missing anything, speak up right away, okay...?
P-probably? If missing anything, speak up right away, okay...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Craft-san—this trip is for your sake.
Right, time to move! Everyone into car!
Right, time to move! Everyone into car!
Off to Line Craft's 『Hanshin JF』!
Off to Line Craft's 『Hanshin JF』!

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Can't wait! First G1... With everyone's support, I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: More importantly, feeling all right? Sleep enough? Are dark circles under eyes just King's imagination?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Too nervous to sleep well, huh? Clueless as always!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Inn near Hanshin Racecourse takes about 8 hours including breaks! Drive carefully.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Start dozing off, King will pinch thighs to wake you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah. Time to move to right lane.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, stay sharp. ...Everyone else fell asleep already. Must be tired too.
choice_data_list: It's fine if you sleep too
It's fine if you sleep too

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: King staying awake to watch over you, dummy. Big responsibility on our shoulders.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Team really grew. Ever imagine van filling up this fast?
Not really. ...When Dad was Trainer, one car wasn't enough, though—
Not really. ...When Dad was Trainer, one car wasn't enough, though—

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text: <username>. Leaving Team <Ascella> trainer role to you. ...Got it? Handle it properly.
Members shrank when taking over. Back then, just the two of us...
Members shrank when taking over. Back then, just the two of us...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, yes. Nostalgic. Look at us now—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Two promising G1-caliber rookies joined too. ...Quite the team now, isn't it?
Line Craft and Cesario brought new life to Team <Ascella>. First meeting them still vivid—
Line Craft and Cesario brought new life to Team <Ascella>. First meeting them still vivid—

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text: All Umamusume loaded into gates. Ready to prove their strength to scout trainers—

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text: Preparations complete. Selection race starts now!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaah……!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Taking the lead early is Rhein Kraft! 
An absolutely flawless start!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa, as expected! Showing her stuff 
right from the break~……! Rumors were true, 
Rhein Kraft's got serious speed!

(Hitting top gear that fast…… 
she's naturally gifted for pure speed!)

(Hitting top gear that fast…… 
she's naturally gifted for pure speed!)

(Laser focus off the blocks, instantly claiming prime 
position……her sheer potential is breathtaking……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa……! 
Still got more……keep pushing……!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Look at that pace control! At this rate, 
Rhein Kraft might just run away with it wire-to-wire!

text_block_list.name: Mid-rank Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
……No, don't count on it. 
Look closely—they've hit the home stretch――!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ――Fuuu……!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
400 meters to go, here comes Cesario! Blistering acceleration! 
Carving right through the pack and pulling away!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Terrifying burst! Leaving the pack 
in the dust! Cesario, in full flight, 
rapidly closing on leader Rhein Kraft!

(Biding her time, holding that immaculate form! 
Not just impressive……she's in a whole different league!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! Knew you'd come……!
Not giving in! Yaaaaaaaaah—!

(She pulled level……! Will Cesario blow past? 
No, Rhein Kraft is stubbornly clinging to the lead!)

(She pulled level……! Will Cesario blow past? 
No, Rhein Kraft is stubbornly clinging to the lead!)

(Rest of field nowhere in sight! 
Turned into a ferocious two-horse duel……!)

text_block_list.name: Kraft & Cesario
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaah!

Roar of crowd, announcer's calls, all faded away. 
That's just how deeply――Rhein Kraft and Cesario gripped me!

(Naturally, every team scrambled to scout them. 
Even elite rookie trainers from my year were dying to sign them)

(Naturally, every team scrambled to scout them. 
Even elite rookie trainers from my year were dying to sign them)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you, Trainer-san! 
I'm Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I am Cesario. 
Thank you deeply for attending our debut selection race.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, we promise to give it our all! 
And――we want to join Team <Ascella>!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Will you take us on as your trainees? 
……We would be honored to learn under you.

――Never expected both to scout me first. Shocking. 
Still wonder why they picked our small team.

Still, now that they're here……I must lead them to victory. 
With raw talent like theirs, I have to match it with total dedication.

Still, now that they're here……I must lead them to victory. 
With raw talent like theirs, I have to match it with total dedication.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Quite so. ……And how do your efforts look so far? 
Regarding Kraft-san's upcoming 『Hanshin JF』— 
do you rate her chances high?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I think we can win.
Yeah. I think we can win.

text_block_list.text:
She won her debut, and her major last month. And her training 
could almost be called perfect. I think we're fully prepared.
choice_data_list: Her first G1. Hope she isn't nervous――
Her first G1. Hope she isn't nervous――

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Then worry not, will you? Slept like a baby 
in the transport. Surprising grit she possesses…… 
might just be strongest of the bunch.

Agreed. Packed with top Junior tier talent, 
no doubt……but Rhein Kraft has what it takes――!

Agreed. Packed with top Junior tier talent, 
no doubt……but Rhein Kraft has what it takes――!

After long transit and short night's rest――moment arrived. 
Race day for Rhein Kraft: 『Hanshin JF』……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Deep breath in……――and out. 
……Right, ready!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Watch me closely, Trainer-san. 
I'm taking first place!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove it out there! 
Prove I belong on your team!

Kraft……let's do this. 
Unleash everything you've got on this G1 stage!

Kraft……let's do this. 
Unleash everything you've got on this G1 stage!
